title: Strengthen the response-centered creativity contrast after failed calibration
description: The current v2 response-centered contrast is cleaner than the instruction-template setup, but it is still weaker than the Olson-style counterpart path the research docs point to. The audit slice shows that several negative rows remain as specific or more specific than the paired positives, while many positives stay generic. Build an audited v3 contrast that tightens content preservation and pair quality: define rejection or filtering rules from the audit slice, prefer content-preserving plain counterparts or rewrites over independently sampled positive/negative stories when feasible, regenerate or filter the pilot pair set, and rerun controlled layer selection plus bounded calibration in both full-text and response-only form if the diagnostics disagree. Only open the pilot output-evaluation gate if the revised direction shows stronger pair separation and a saner coefficient-response pattern.

title: Run bounded Olson-style extraction sensitivity on the v3 counterpart slice
description: The v3 counterpart rewrite slice fixed pair quality enough to remove most of the old content-drift excuses, but it still did not recover a stable dense creativity direction: the full-text sweep collapses to layer 6 with 0.354839 positive-greater-than-negative fraction, the response-only sweep shifts to layer 22 with 0.387097 fraction, and both calibration branches remain non-monotone. Before treating this as a meaningful negative result for the Gemma 2 2B MacBook lane or reopening the output gate, run one bounded Phase 1 sensitivity that compares the current PCA-on-pair-differences extraction against an Olson-style mean-difference or CAA extraction on the same v3 counterpart slice. If the automatic rewrite slice still looks qualitatively weak, allow a tiny hand-audited subset for the comparison, but keep it bounded. The goal is to distinguish a true stack-level negative result from the last major methodological mismatch to the strongest prior creativity-steering paper.
close_reason: Bounded Olson-style sensitivity completed on the v3 counterpart slice. Mean-difference extraction recovered a usable full-text Phase 1 candidate at layer 23 with a bounded coeff regime around 0.5-1.0, so the method-mismatch question is resolved and the output gate is now the next blocker before decomposition.

title: Freeze initial runtime and prompt split
description: Lock the first local environment, define the initial creative/uncreative prompt split, and record the exact configuration before claim-bearing runs.

title: Add generation-side creativity steering smoke
description: Use the selected pilot dense direction to run a first generation-side steering smoke on a small pilot subset. Save before/after generations plus exact steering settings so extraction-only results are not mistaken for behavioral replication.

title: Build complete local paper corpus from research docs
description: Expand the paper manifest from the current placeholder set to the full research-doc citation corpus, download full local artifacts, add an index for agents, and enforce coverage with tests.

title: Calibrate the v2 late-layer creativity direction before decomposition
description: The response-centered v2 contrast recovered a real late-layer candidate at layer 24, but the pilot signal is still weak and the bounded generation smoke only shows subtle differences. Run the next pilot checks needed to decide whether the v2 dense direction is strong enough to carry into decomposition: at minimum, a bounded steering-scale sanity sweep and a small pair-quality audit or equivalent creativity-side evaluation on the v2 direction.

title: Second-pass research-doc paper sweep
description: Add the remaining named papers from research/*.md to the local paper corpus, especially missing activation-steering, latent-reasoning, and evaluation references from the brainstorming docs.

title: Strengthen pilot creativity metric after order-robust output gate collapse
description: The Phase 1 output gate now exists and has been run on the recovered full-text mean-difference layer-23 direction, but the secondary review found that the first single-order judge was heavily biased toward story A. After switching to order-robust paired judging that requires the same winner under both A/B orderings, the pilot gate collapses almost entirely to ties: prompt-only creativity vs neutral is all ties, dense vs neutral is all ties, and only dense-0.5 vs prompt-baseline shows a tiny 2-vs-1 creativity edge with worse coherence. This means decomposition must remain blocked, but it does not yet justify a stack-level negative result because the current local judge is too insensitive to separate even the prompt-only creativity baseline from neutral. The follow-up must be falsifiable rather than metric-shopping. Required order: (1) run a small blinded manual audit on the existing cached output-gate stories to determine whether prompt-only creativity vs neutral is visibly separable to a human under a locked rubric; (2) build or choose one stronger pilot creativity-side metric grounded in that audit and in the existing creativity-evaluation papers, with explicit order-bias controls; (3) rerun the gate on the cached generated outputs before generating any new stories or retuning the layer/coefficients. If the stronger metric can separate prompt-only creativity from neutral but still shows no dense effect, treat that as the first strong Phase 1 negative result for the Gemma 2 2B lane. If the stronger metric still cannot separate prompt-only creativity from neutral, treat evaluation sensitivity or prompt-harness quality as the live blocker rather than decomposition.

title: Implement first creativity-direction replication slice
description: Run the smallest real Gemma 2 2B creativity-direction replication artifact on the frozen split and save the result under results/creativity_direction/.

title: Rereview scaffold against experiment docs and resattn
Resolve remaining doc-hierarchy and base-config drift
description: Fix the last alignment drifts by setting the 65K base SAE config, tightening the mission framing, and codifying the priority order across the research docs.

title: Control lexical template confound in creativity layer selection
description: The raw pilot layer sweep selected layer 0 with perfect pair separation, which is likely dominated by lexical differences between the creative and uncreative instruction templates. Add a control or revised selection procedure so early-layer prompt-template leakage is not mistaken for a creativity representation.

title: Final rigor audit and novelty alignment
description: Audit creativedecomp against resattn for structural rigor, tighten AGENTS coverage, and align the live strategy docs with experiment-novelty.md.

title: Compare signed creativity-direction decomposition methods on pilot slice
description: Implement and compare at least two signed decomposition methods for the dense creativity direction on the frozen pilot slice before any confirmatory decomposition run. The comparison should explicitly avoid naive dense-vector SAE encoding and save method notes and artifacts under results/feature_decomposition/.

title: Run a matched refusal baseline on Gemma 2 2B before any model-scale escalation
description: Use the same Gemma 2 2B local stack, the same style of pilot-only layer/scale discipline, and a matched output-level evaluation path to run one simpler-concept control before any jump to a larger model. Refusal is the preferred first control because it is the cleanest well-established behavioral direction in the literature. The goal is not to start decomposition yet. The goal is to learn whether this stack can produce a clear output-level effect for a simpler concept under a matched pipeline. If refusal works cleanly while creativity does not, the current creativity negative result becomes much stronger and more novelty-aligned. If refusal also fails, the 2B lane likely has a broader stack or harness weakness and model-scale sensitivity becomes easier to justify.

title: Freeze pilot output-level creativity gate before decomposition
description: Once creativedecomp-02c produces a cleaner dense-direction candidate, run the missing Phase 1 output gate before any decomposition work. Lock a pilot-only evaluation harness with at least one creativity-side metric and one coherence/usefulness check, prefer response-only scoring when possible, save the exact judge or metric prompts, and verify that the dense direction changes outputs at the sequence level rather than only shifting internal probe projections. Compare against the prompt-only creativity baseline explicitly, but do not require dense steering to outperform prompting on the pilot slice; the goal of this gate is to establish a real causal output effect and characterize the tradeoff honestly. Only after this gate passes should creativedecomp-npt become ready.
close_reason: The pilot output-level gate is now defined, implemented, and run. The initial single-order summary was invalidated by strong story-order bias, and the corrected order-robust rerun on cached generated outputs does not pass the gate. Decomposition remains blocked, and the next honest blocker is strengthening the pilot creativity-side metric under creativedecomp-8o1.

title: Synthesize the first strong Gemma 2 2B Phase 1 negative result and choose the next bounded lane
description: The tightened prompt-grounded-creativity follow-up on cached output-gate stories has now done what creativedecomp-8o1 was supposed to test: a blinded manual audit and the stricter order-robust gate both recover a weak prompt-only creativity baseline effect, but dense steering at layer 23 still shows no output-level effect versus neutral. Treat this as the first strong Phase 1 negative result for the Gemma 2 2B MacBook lane and do the bounded follow-up needed before any new implementation: synthesize exactly what the negative result does and does not establish, compare the legitimate next options (for example: stop at the 2B negative-result write-up, run one bounded model-scale sensitivity, or run one matched simpler-concept baseline), and recommend one path without reopening decomposition prematurely.

title: Redesign creativity-vs-plain extraction contrast after template-control failure
description: The template-controlled layer sweep showed that no layer clears the current instruction-template leakage control, so the creative-vs-uncreative instruction pair is not a valid basis for freezing a dense creativity layer. Design and implement a more tightly matched contrastive extraction setup or revised selection procedure, then rerun layer selection before decomposition work resumes.

title: Pre-implementation grounding audit
Run pilot layer sweep for dense creativity direction
description: Evaluate the frozen pilot split across a bounded layer set so the dense creativity-direction layer is chosen by evidence rather than scaffold default. Save artifacts under results/creativity_direction/ and compare pairwise projection separation across layers.

title: Repair base-model story prompting for steering evaluation
description: The first generation-side smoke on Gemma 2 2B produced mostly prompt-meta continuations rather than clean story outputs. Design and validate a continuation-style or otherwise base-model-compatible prompting harness before interpreting steering-side creativity effects.
